rules.proven: an edge, 30+ trades, and every test that applies passed; anything else is not proven
rules.luck: deflated Sharpe >= 0.95 when the family's variants are priced (Bailey & Lopez de Prado 2014, N = trials, V = variance of their daily Sharpes); else Harvey-Liu Bonferroni haircut, one-sided adjusted p < 0.05
rules.shuffle: actual at or above the 95th percentile of 1000 seeded draws
rules.walk_forward: 3-month train / 1-month test rolling folds; pick on train, report test; passes when the summed test months beat as-is and the change was picked
rules.sensitivity: each threshold at -50%, -20%, +20%, +50%: the edge stays above 0 at every value
rules.regime: the edge is above 0 in both SPY up months and SPY down months
rules.risk: max drawdown, longest losing streak and worst day under realistic costs (reported, not tested)
